name: FusedResidualRmsNormBackward
reference:
import torch

def run(grad_output, x, normalized, rstd, weight):
    N = normalized.shape[-1]
    grad_norm = grad_output.to(torch.float32) * weight.to(torch.float32)
    grad_x = grad_norm * rstd.to(torch.float32) / N
    mean_grad = grad_x * (-normalized.to(torch.float32))
    grad_x = grad_x + mean_grad.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) * normalized.to(torch.float32)
    grad_weight = (grad_output.to(torch.float32) * normalized.to(torch.float32)).sum(dim=tuple(range(grad_output.ndim - 1)))
    grad_hidden = grad_x.to(grad_output.dtype)
    grad_residual = grad_x.to(grad_output.dtype)
    return grad_hidden, grad_residual, grad_weight
description: Backward pass for fused residual + RMSNorm. Computes gradients w.r.t. hidden_states, residual, and weight. Pure PyTorch: gradient computation for RMSNorm with residual addition.
